usage: Conceptual teaching illustrations, not measured delivery data, live GPS, architectural guarantees or screenshots.

images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished French educational illustration for a professional presentation explaining the real architecture of a local delivery-planning app to nontechnical adults. Landscape 16:9 composition on warm off-white #F4F7F7 background, dark teal #173039, muted teal #146C78 and copper #925E27. Restrained editorial illustration, not a futuristic dashboard. Five clearly distinct real-world metaphor stations with large readable French labels: upper left a person at computer labelled « ÉCRAN »; upper centre reception desk checking a delivery form labelled « ACCUEIL API »; lower centre organized archive with queued job folders labelled « REGISTRE »; upper right planning workbench with a small route board labelled « ATELIER WORKER »; far right, clearly separated network providers represented by an atlas and a text-response sheet labelled « SERVICES EXTERNES ». Relationship arrows must be EXACT: screen to API and API back to screen; API to register; register to worker; worker back to register; worker to external services and external services back to worker. No direct API-to-worker arrow. Do not connect screen directly to database or external services. No other arrows. Leave generous white space; only these five labels, no body text, no title, no logo or watermark. These are explanatory metaphors, not a screenshot or claim of live delivery. Flat precise illustration with minimal depth, legible rather than ornate.
images.editOrFinalPrompt: Edit this educational architecture illustration. Preserve exactly the five stations, labels, style, colors and current arrows. Add ONLY one copper arrow from the REGISTRE archive upward to the ACCUEIL API reception desk, next to the existing downward teal API-to-register arrow. This shows the API reads results back from the registry as well as writing requests. Keep a visible gap so the two arrows remain distinct. No arrow directly between API and worker. No other new elements. Landscape unchanged.

Use case: scientific-educational. French educational illustration for a senior technical presentation to ordinary nontechnical adults. Landscape 16:9 on off-white #F4F7F7; dark teal #173039, teal #146C78, copper #925E27. A route-planning worktable viewed from above at slight angle, with a clearly fictional miniature street grid, a depot icon, three drop-off pins and two small delivery vans. In left half labelled « PROPOSITION », hands arrange delivery-stop cards on the route board. In right half labelled « CONTRÔLE », a separate person checks a sheet with three large rows represented by parcel, clock and paired pin symbols and clear checkboxes. Left and right are distinct responsibilities, no AI brain/robot imagery. A thin document-transfer arrow from proposal board to checklist only. No actual Montreal street names or real map, no costs/distances/time values, no claims of optimality. Only exact French labels PROPOSITION and CONTRÔLE, no title, no tiny unreadable text, no branding. Elegant explanatory illustration, plentiful breathing room.

Use case: scientific-educational. A clear professional illustration showing two separate records in a software application, understandable without IT knowledge. Landscape 4:3 composition, warm off-white #F4F7F7 with deep teal and muted copper. Left an archive cabinet with delivery order folders and receipts labelled « DONNÉES MÉTIER ». Right a separate open notebook with five numbered tabs 1 2 3 4 5 and a visible bookmark at the third tab labelled « ÉTAPE DU TRAVAIL ». Leave a generous gap between the two, no connecting arrow, no shared lock suggesting atomic synchronization. Do not draw a backup success badge or a restart arrow. Only these two French labels and five tab numerals. No personal information, no actual code, no logos, no title. Elegant tactile editorial illustration, clean outlines and subtle paper shading, modest depth. This symbolizes the separate Genesis application SQLite database and LangGraph checkpoint database, not a product screenshot.
images.editOrFinalPrompt: Edit this educational illustration while preserving archive cabinet, notebook, composition and palette. Correct the archive's inner folders: replace BONs DE LIVRAISON with COMMANDES; replace FACTURES with ÉVÉNEMENTS; completely remove the euro symbol and any other currency signs. These folders are software records, not invoices or proofs of delivery. Add a large legible caption ÉTAPE DU TRAVAIL above the right notebook in deep teal. Keep DONNÉES MÉTIER on cabinet. Keep 1 2 3 4 5 tabs and bookmark at third tab. Do not add any other text or arrows. This must represent two distinct stores, not an atomic combined backup.
